policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="rpcId" value="@{
            var raw = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? "";
            if (!raw.TrimStart().StartsWith("{")) { return JValue.CreateNull(); }
            var id = JObject.Parse(raw)["id"];
            return id ?? JValue.CreateNull();
        }" />

                    @("https://login.microsoftonline.com/" + (string)context.Variables["oboTenant"] + "/oauth2/v2.0/token")
                    POST
                    
                        application/x-www-form-urlencoded
                    
                    @{
                        var fields = new[] {
                            "grant_type=" + Uri.EscapeDataString("urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer"),
                            "requested_token_use=on_behalf_of",
                            "client_id=" + Uri.EscapeDataString("{{gateway-app-client-id}}"),
                            "client_assertion_type=" + Uri.EscapeDataString("urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer"),
                            "client_assertion=" + Uri.EscapeDataString((string)context.Variables["federatedAssertion"]),
                            "assertion=" + Uri.EscapeDataString((string)context.Variables["inboundToken"]),
                            "scope=" + Uri.EscapeDataString("{{reporting-obo-scopes}}")
                        };
                        return string.Join("\u0026", fields);
                    }
                
                <set-variable name="oboOutcome" value="@{
                    var resp = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("oboResponse");
                    if (resp == null) { return "temporarily_unavailable"; }
                    if (resp.StatusCode == 200) { return "ok"; }
                    if (resp.StatusCode == 429 || resp.StatusCode >= 500) { return "temporarily_unavailable"; }
                    var err = resp.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var codes = err["error_codes"] as JArray;
                    var codeList = codes == null ? new List() : codes.Select(c => (int)c).ToList();
                    if (codeList.Contains(65001)) { return "consent_required"; }
                    if (codeList.Contains(53003)) { return "access_blocked"; }
                    if ((string)err["error"] == "interaction_required" || err["claims"] != null) { return "interaction_required"; }
                    return "backend_auth_failed";
                }" />
                
                    
                        <set-variable name="oboBody" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["oboResponse"]).Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />

                                    var claims = (string)err["claims"] ?? "";
                                    var encoded = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(claims));
                                    return "Bearer error=\"insufficient_claims\", claims=\"" + encoded + "\"";
                                }
